ui.addressInput.placeholder.description: The placeholder of a field that searches for an address or a place. It is also the name of the field when no label names it.

ui.alert.dismiss.description: The name of the button that closes a message or a toast.

ui.badge.remove.description: The name of the button that removes a chip, such as a tag. The label is the text of the chip.

ui.calendar.chooseMonthYear.description: The name of the panel that holds the month picker and the year picker.

ui.calendar.nextDecade.description: The name of the button that shows the ten years after in the year picker.

ui.calendar.nextMonth.description: The name of the button that shows the month after.

ui.calendar.nextYear.description: The name of the button that shows the year after in the month picker.

ui.calendar.previousDecade.description: The name of the button that shows the ten years before in the year picker.

ui.calendar.previousMonth.description: The name of the button that shows the month before.

ui.calendar.previousYear.description: The name of the button that shows the year before in the month picker.

ui.calendar.selectMonth.description: The name of the grid of months in the month picker.

ui.calendar.selectYear.description: The name of the grid of years in the year picker.

ui.chart.chart.description: The name of the fullscreen dialog of a chart that has no title.

ui.chart.copyData.description: The action that copies the values of a chart to the clipboard.

ui.chart.data.description: The title of the dialog with the values of a chart that has no title.

ui.chart.downloadCsv.description: The action that downloads the values of a chart as a CSV file.

ui.chart.downloadJpg.description: The action that downloads a chart as a JPG image.

ui.chart.downloadPng.description: The action that downloads a chart as a PNG image.

ui.chart.fullscreen.description: The action that opens a chart in a large dialog.

ui.chart.legend.description: The name of the legend of a chart, which names the series by their colors.

ui.chart.menu.description: The name of the menu of a chart. The title is the title of the chart.

ui.chart.moreEntries.description: The name of the panel with the legend entries that do not fit.

ui.chart.nextEntries.description: The name of the button that shows the page of legend entries after.

ui.chart.previousEntries.description: The name of the button that shows the page of legend entries before.

ui.chart.showMore.description: The name of the button that shows the legend entries that do not fit. The count is the number of those entries.

ui.chart.untitledMenu.description: The name of the menu of a chart that has no title.

ui.chart.value.description: The name of the color scale bar of a chart that has no name of its own.

ui.chart.viewData.description: The action that opens a dialog with the values of a chart as a table.

ui.chart.viewDataFor.description: The name of the button that opens a dialog with the values of a chart as a table. The title is the title of the chart.

ui.chat.assistant.description: The hidden label before a chat message from the assistant. A screen reader reads it before the message.

ui.chat.attach.description: The name of the button that opens a file picker to attach files to a chat message.

ui.chat.done.description: The status of a step of the assistant that ended well.

ui.chat.failed.description: The status of a step of the assistant that ended with an error.

ui.chat.missing.defaultMessage: This chat cannot show a “{name}” block.
ui.chat.missing.description: Shown in place of a block of a chat reply that the app cannot draw. The name is the name of the block.

ui.chat.placeholder.description: The hint text of the empty field where the reader writes a chat message.

ui.chat.prompt.description: The name of the field where the reader writes a chat message.

ui.chat.replying.description: Spoken while a reply of the assistant arrives in a chat.

ui.chat.running.description: The status of a step of the assistant that has not ended.

ui.chat.send.description: The name of the button that sends a chat message.

ui.chat.stop.description: The name of the button that stops the reply that the assistant writes.

ui.chat.system.description: The hidden label before a status line of a chat, which no person said. A screen reader reads it before the line.

ui.chat.user.description: The hidden label before a chat message that the reader sent. A screen reader reads it before the message.

ui.chat.views.defaultMessage: {views, plural, one {# embedded view} other {# embedded views}}
ui.chat.views.description: Spoken after a reply of the assistant that holds views, such as charts. The count is the number of views.

ui.color.alpha.description: The name of the slider that sets the opacity of a color.

ui.color.alphaChannel.description: The name of the field of the opacity of a color.

ui.color.area.description: The name of the two-axis area that sets the saturation and the brightness of a color.

ui.color.areaValue.description: The value text of the color area. Each value is a percent from 0 to 100.

ui.color.channel.description: The name of the field of one color channel. The channel is its letter: R, G, or B.

ui.color.choose.description: The name of the dialog of a color picker.

ui.color.copyHex.description: The name of the button that copies the hexadecimal code of a color.

ui.color.eyedropper.description: The name of the button that takes a color from a point on the screen.

ui.color.hex.description: The label of the field of the hexadecimal code of a color.

ui.color.hue.description: The name of the slider that sets the hue of a color.

ui.color.swatches.description: The name of the group of preset colors.

ui.combobox.create.description: The option at the end of a combobox list that creates a new item from the typed text. The name is the typed text.

ui.combobox.placeholder.description: The placeholder of a field that filters a list of options as the reader types.

ui.combobox.unselected.defaultMessage: Select an option from the list.
ui.combobox.unselected.description: The browser validation message of a required combobox that holds typed text but no selected option.

ui.commandPalette.label.description: The name of the dialog that searches the commands of an app. It has no visible title.

ui.commandPalette.placeholder.description: The placeholder of the search field of the command palette, and its name.

ui.common.cancel.description: The label of a button that stops an action and makes no change.

ui.common.clear.description: The name of a button that empties a field.

ui.common.clearSelection.description: The name of a button that removes the selected value of a picker.

ui.common.close.description: The name of a button that closes a dialog, a sheet, or a panel.

ui.common.confirm.description: The label of a button that does the action that a dialog asks about.

ui.common.filters.description: The name of a group of filter controls, and the label of the button that opens them.

ui.common.loading.description: The name of a spinner that shows that content or an action is loading.

ui.common.noResults.description: The text of a list when a search finds no item.

ui.common.selected.description: The summary of a picker that holds more than one selected item.

ui.common.system.description: A setting that follows the setting of the operating system or the browser.

ui.confirm.title.description: The default title of a dialog that asks the reader to confirm an action.

ui.copyButton.copied.description: The name of the copy button, and the announcement, after a copy succeeds.

ui.copyButton.copy.description: The name of a button that copies a value to the clipboard.

ui.creditCardInput.expiry.description: The name of the field of the expiration date of a payment card, when no label names it.

ui.creditCardInput.invalidExpiry.description: The error of an expiration date that cannot be valid, such as a past month. The format is the letters of the mask, such as MM/YY.

ui.creditCardInput.number.description: The name of the field of a payment card number, when no label names it.

ui.creditCardInput.securityCode.description: The name of the field of the 3- or 4-digit security code of a payment card, when no label names it.

ui.dashboard.canceled.description: Spoken when a canceled drag puts a tile back at its place.

ui.dashboard.cannotGo.defaultMessage: {item} cannot go here. A drop now changes nothing.
ui.dashboard.cannotGo.description: Spoken while a dragged tile is over a place where it cannot go.

ui.dashboard.cell.defaultMessage: column {column} of {columns}, row {row}, {width, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}} wide
ui.dashboard.cell.description: The place of a dashboard tile: its first column, the count of columns, its row, and its width.

ui.dashboard.clearSelection.description: The name of the button that clears the selection that a dashboard tile holds.

ui.dashboard.dragStart.defaultMessage: Picked up {item} at {cell}. Use the arrow keys to move it. Press Space to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
ui.dashboard.dragStart.description: Spoken when the reader picks up a dashboard tile. The cell is the place of the tile.

ui.dashboard.droppedAt.description: Spoken when a dragged tile drops at a new place.

ui.dashboard.droppedUnchanged.defaultMessage: Dropped {item}. The board did not change.
ui.dashboard.droppedUnchanged.description: Spoken when a dragged tile drops and nothing moves.

ui.dashboard.duplicate.description: The name of the button that makes a copy of a dashboard tile.

ui.dashboard.duplicated.description: Spoken when a tile action makes a copy of a tile.

ui.dashboard.expand.description: The name of the button that opens a dashboard tile in a dialog.

ui.dashboard.failed.description: The error text of a dashboard tile whose widget threw an error.

ui.dashboard.missing.defaultMessage: This dashboard cannot show a “{widget}” tile.
ui.dashboard.missing.description: The text of a dashboard tile whose kind no widget renders. The widget is the name of the kind.

ui.dashboard.moves.description: Spoken while a dragged tile is over an empty place.

ui.dashboard.remove.description: The name of the button that removes a dashboard tile.

ui.dashboard.removed.description: Spoken when a tile action removes a tile.

ui.dashboard.resize.description: The name of the handle that changes the size of a dashboard tile.

ui.dashboard.retry.description: The label of the button that renders a failed dashboard tile again.

ui.dashboard.shifts.description: Spoken while a dragged tile is over a place where a drop moves it next to another tile.

ui.dashboard.swaps.description: Spoken while a dragged tile is over a place where a drop swaps it with another tile.

ui.dashboard.tidied.defaultMessage: {moved, plural, =0 {The board is already tidy.} one {Tidied the board. Moved # tile up.} other {Tidied the board. Moved # tiles up.}}
ui.dashboard.tidied.description: Spoken when a tidy packs the board. The count is the number of tiles that moved.

ui.dateInput.between.description: The error of a date field whose date is before the first date or after the last date that it accepts.

ui.dateInput.clear.description: The name of the button that clears a date field.

ui.dateInput.invalid.description: The error of a date field whose text is not a date. The format is the pattern of the field, such as DD/MM/YYYY.

ui.dateInput.name.description: The name of a date field that has no label.

ui.dateInput.onOrAfter.defaultMessage: Enter a date on or after {min}
ui.dateInput.onOrAfter.description: The error of a date field whose date is before the first date that it accepts.

ui.dateInput.onOrBefore.defaultMessage: Enter a date on or before {max}
ui.dateInput.onOrBefore.description: The error of a date field whose date is after the last date that it accepts.

ui.datePicker.actions.description: The name of the toolbar with the Clear and Today buttons below the calendar.

ui.datePicker.backToPresets.description: The button that goes back from the custom range to the list of ranges.

ui.datePicker.chooseDate.description: The name of the panel of a date picker, which holds the calendar.

ui.datePicker.closeCalendar.description: The name of the button that closes the calendar of a date field.

ui.datePicker.customRange.description: The button that opens a start date field and an end date field in place of the list of ranges, and the name of that panel.

ui.datePicker.end.description: The label of the field of the last date of a custom range.

ui.datePicker.lastDays.description: A range of a date picker: today and the days before it. The count is the number of days, today included.

ui.datePicker.lastMonth.description: A range of a date picker: all the days of the month before this month.

ui.datePicker.lastYear.description: A range of a date picker: all the days of the year before this year.

ui.datePicker.openCalendar.description: The name of the button that opens the calendar of a date field.

ui.datePicker.selectDate.description: The text of an empty date picker that holds one date.

ui.datePicker.selectDates.description: The text of an empty date picker that holds a start date and an end date.

ui.datePicker.selectRange.description: The text of an empty date picker that holds a range, such as Last 7 days, and the name of its list of ranges.

ui.datePicker.start.description: The label of the field of the first date of a custom range.

ui.datePicker.thisMonth.description: A range of a date picker: from the first day of this month to today.

ui.datePicker.thisYear.description: A range of a date picker: from the first day of this year to today.

ui.datePicker.today.description: The label of the button that selects the date of today.

ui.datePicker.yesterday.description: A range of a date picker: the day before today.

ui.fileUpload.announced.description: Spoken when the reader selects files. The names are the file names, joined by commas.

ui.fileUpload.browse.description: The name of the button that opens the file picker of a file field.

ui.fileUpload.chooseDifferent.description: The name of the drop zone after a selection. A press opens the file picker again.

ui.fileUpload.chooseFile.description: The placeholder of an empty file field.

ui.fileUpload.clear.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Clear selected file} other {Clear selected files}}
ui.fileUpload.clear.description: The name of the button that clears the selected files of a file field.

ui.fileUpload.dropClick.defaultMessage: Drop files here or click to browse
ui.fileUpload.dropClick.description: The prompt of an empty drop zone on a device with a mouse.

ui.fileUpload.dropTap.defaultMessage: Drop files here or tap to browse
ui.fileUpload.dropTap.description: The prompt of an empty drop zone on a touch device.

ui.fileUpload.reset.description: The label of the button that clears the selected files.

ui.fileUpload.selected.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# file selected} other {# files selected}}
ui.fileUpload.selected.description: The summary of a selection of more than one file.

ui.fileUpload.upload.description: The label of the button that opens the file picker.

ui.fileUpload.uploadFile.description: The name of the file input of a drop zone.

ui.grid.addRow.description: The name of the button that adds the new row to a grid.

ui.grid.allSelected.description: Spoken when the reader selects all the rows of the grid.

ui.grid.allSelectedOnPage.defaultMessage: All rows on this page selected
ui.grid.allSelectedOnPage.description: Spoken when the reader selects all the rows of the current page of the grid.

ui.grid.apply.description: The button that applies the filter of a column of a grid.

ui.grid.autoSize.description: The menu item of a grid column that opens the choices that fit the widths of the columns.

ui.grid.autoSizeAll.description: The menu item that fits the width of each grid column to its content.

ui.grid.autoSizeBody.defaultMessage: This fits every column to its content and replaces the column widths you saved. Your other layout preferences — order, visibility, and pinned columns — stay just as they are.
ui.grid.autoSizeBody.description: The text of the dialog that asks before it fits every column of a grid to its content.

ui.grid.autoSizeColumn.description: The menu item that fits the width of a grid column to its content.

ui.grid.autoSizeConfirm.description: The button that fits every column of a grid to its content.

ui.grid.autoSizeTitle.description: The title of the dialog that asks before it fits every column of a grid to its content.

ui.grid.batchActions.description: The name of the toolbar of the actions on the selected rows of a grid.

ui.grid.blocked.defaultMessage: {step, select, undo {Cannot undo while a cell has an edit} other {Cannot redo while a cell has an edit}}
ui.grid.blocked.description: Spoken when the grid cannot undo or redo, because a cell has an open edit.

ui.grid.cellInNewRow.description: The name of a cell of the new row of a grid by its column.

ui.grid.cellInRow.description: The name of a cell of a grid by its column and its row number.

ui.grid.cellMenu.description: The name of the context menu of a grid cell.

ui.grid.cellOutcome.defaultMessage: {column} {outcome, select, updated {updated} undone {undone} redone {redone} pasted {pasted} filled {filled} other {not saved}}
ui.grid.cellOutcome.description: Spoken when an edit of one cell of the grid saves, undoes, redoes, pastes, fills, or fails. The column names the cell.

ui.grid.cellsOutcome.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# cell} other {# cells}} {outcome, select, updated {updated} undone {undone} redone {redone} pasted {pasted} filled {filled} other {not saved}}
ui.grid.cellsOutcome.description: Spoken when an edit of many cells of the grid saves, undoes, redoes, pastes, fills, or fails. The count is the number of cells.

ui.grid.clearColor.description: The menu item that removes the color of a group of a grid.

ui.grid.clearFilters.description: The menu item and the button that remove the filters of a grid.

ui.grid.clearSort.description: The menu item that removes the sort of a grid.

ui.grid.collapseAllGroups.description: The menu item that closes every row group of a grid.

ui.grid.collapseDetails.description: The name of the button that closes the detail panel of a row of a grid.

ui.grid.collapseGroup.description: The menu item that closes a row group of a grid.

ui.grid.collapseGroupNamed.description: The name of the button that closes a row group of a grid. The group is its value.

ui.grid.collapseNamed.description: The name of the button that hides the columns of a column group.

ui.grid.color.description: The button of a group with no color that opens the color choices.

ui.grid.colorFor.description: The name of the button of a group with no color that opens the color choices. The group is its name.

ui.grid.colorOf.description: The name of the button of a group with a color that opens the color choices, such as "Red color for Contact".

ui.grid.columnGroupName.description: The name of a column group in an announcement of the group editor, such as "Contact group".

ui.grid.columnMenu.description: The name of the context menu of a grid column. The column is its name.

ui.grid.columnName.description: The name of a column in a reorder announcement, such as "Price column".

ui.grid.columnNumber.description: The name of a column with no label of its own, inside an announcement. The number is its place, from 1.

ui.grid.columns.description: The name of the list of columns in the column manager of a grid.

ui.grid.commitRefused.description: The error of a cell edit that the app did not save, when the app gives no reason.

ui.grid.copy.description: The menu item that copies the selected cells of a grid.

ui.grid.dataGrid.description: The name of a grid that the app gives no name.

ui.grid.discardCell.description: The name of the button that drops the edit of a cell. The cell names its column and row.

ui.grid.discarded.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# change discarded} other {# changes discarded}}
ui.grid.discarded.description: Spoken when the grid drops edits that were not saved. The count is the number of edits.

ui.grid.droppedIn.description: Spoken when a dragged column or group drops at a place in the group editor.

ui.grid.droppedWhereStarted.description: Spoken when a dragged column or group drops over no place, so nothing moves.

ui.grid.editCell.description: The name of the editor of a cell of a grid. The cell names its column and row.

ui.grid.editFilters.description: The menu item that opens the filter of a grid column to change it.

ui.grid.editor.description: The group editor as a whole, as a place in an announcement, when a column is over no group.

ui.grid.expandAllGroups.description: The menu item that opens every row group of a grid.

ui.grid.expandDetails.description: The name of the button that opens the detail panel of a row of a grid.

ui.grid.expandGroup.description: The menu item that opens a row group of a grid.

ui.grid.expandGroupNamed.description: The name of the button that opens a row group of a grid. The group is its value.

ui.grid.expandNamed.description: The name of the button that shows the columns of a collapsed column group.

ui.grid.export.description: The menu item and the button that open the export choices of a grid.

ui.grid.exportCsv.description: The action that downloads the rows of a grid as a CSV file.

ui.grid.exportExcel.description: The action that downloads the rows of a grid as an Excel workbook.

ui.grid.exportTo.description: The action of an export type that the app adds to a grid. The type is its name.

ui.grid.exporting.description: Shown while a grid exports its rows.

ui.grid.fillDown.description: The menu item that copies the first row of a cell range of a grid down the range.

ui.grid.fillLeft.description: The menu item that copies the first column of a cell range of a grid to the left.

ui.grid.fillRight.description: The menu item that copies the first column of a cell range of a grid to the right.

ui.grid.filterActive.description: The name of the header button of a grid column whose filter is on.

ui.grid.filterColumn.description: The menu item that opens the filter of a grid column. The column is its name.

ui.grid.filterColumns.description: The hint text and the name of the field that filters the columns in the column manager of a grid.

ui.grid.filterNamed.description: The name of the header button that opens the filter of a grid column.

ui.grid.forRow.description: Adds the row to a save announcement of the grid, such as "Name updated for Alice".

ui.grid.frozenColumn.description: The name of the checkbox of a column that the reader cannot hide, because it is locked or pinned.

ui.grid.groupBy.description: The menu item that groups the rows of a grid by a column. The column is its name.

ui.grid.groupHandle.description: The name of the handle that drags a group to a new place in the list of groups.

ui.grid.groupMenu.description: The name of the context menu of a group of a grid. The group is its name.

ui.grid.groupName.description: The hint text of the field that names a column group of a grid.

ui.grid.groupNameFor.description: The name of the field that names a column group of a grid. The group is its current name.

ui.grid.groupPosition.description: The place of a dragged group in the list of groups, inside an announcement of the group editor.

ui.grid.hid.description: Spoken when the reader hides a column of the grid.

ui.grid.isOver.description: Spoken while a column or a group is dragged over a place in the group editor, such as "Name column is over Contact group.".

ui.grid.keepWidths.description: The button that closes the dialog and keeps the saved column widths of a grid.

ui.grid.loadFailed.description: The error of a grid whose rows did not load.

ui.grid.manageColumns.description: The menu item that opens the dialog that shows, hides, and orders the columns of a grid.

ui.grid.manageRows.description: The menu item that opens the dialog that orders and colors the row groups of a grid.

ui.grid.moveTo.description: The menu item that moves a column into a column group of a grid.

ui.grid.newGroup.description: The button that adds a column group, and the first name of the new group.

ui.grid.newRow.description: The name of the row where the reader types a new row of a grid.

ui.grid.nextPage.description: The name of the button that shows the page of a grid after this one.

ui.grid.no.description: The false choice of a yes-or-no cell of a grid.

ui.grid.noColor.description: The color choice that removes the color of a group.

ui.grid.noColumnsInGroup.description: The text of a column group of a grid that holds no columns.

ui.grid.noRows.description: The page status of a grid that has no rows.

ui.grid.noUngroupedColumns.description: The text of the ungrouped columns of a grid when every column is in a group.

ui.grid.nothingTo.defaultMessage: {step, select, undo {Nothing to undo} other {Nothing to redo}}
ui.grid.nothingTo.description: Spoken when the reader asks the grid to undo or redo and there is nothing to do.

ui.grid.pageNumber.description: The page status of a grid that does not know its number of pages.

ui.grid.pageOf.description: The page status of a grid that knows its number of pages.

ui.grid.pagination.description: The name of the page navigation of a grid with no name.

ui.grid.paginationOf.description: The name of the page navigation of a grid. The grid is its name.

ui.grid.paginationWord.description: The hidden word after the name of a grid that names its page navigation.

ui.grid.paletteColor.defaultMessage: {color, select, zinc {Zinc} red {Red} amber {Amber} green {Green} blue {Blue} rose {Rose} violet {Violet} sky {Sky} other {{color}}}
ui.grid.paletteColor.description: The name of a color that a group of a grid can take.

ui.grid.partial.description: Joins the saved and the failed cells of one save of the grid, such as "Name updated, 2 cells not saved".

ui.grid.perPage.description: The value of the rows-per-page control of a grid, such as "25 / page".

ui.grid.pin.description: The menu item of a grid column that opens the pin choices.

ui.grid.pinColumn.description: The name of the button that opens the pin choices of a column in the column manager of a grid.

ui.grid.pinLeft.description: The menu item that pins a column of a grid to the left edge.

ui.grid.pinRight.description: The menu item that pins a column of a grid to the right edge.

ui.grid.pinned.defaultMessage: Pinned {column} to the {side, select, left {left} other {right}}
ui.grid.pinned.description: Spoken when the reader pins a column of the grid to an edge.

ui.grid.pixels.description: The width of a column of the grid, read by its resize handle.

ui.grid.previousPage.description: The name of the button that shows the page of a grid before this one.

ui.grid.print.description: The action that prints the rows of a grid.

ui.grid.range.defaultMessage: Range of {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} and {cols, plural, one {# column} other {# columns}}, {fromColumn} row {fromRow} to {toColumn} row {toRow}
ui.grid.range.description: Spoken when the reader selects a range of cells of the grid: its size, and its two corners by column and row number.

ui.grid.rangeOf.description: The page status of a grid: the first and the last row of the page, and the count of rows.

ui.grid.removeFromGroup.description: The menu item that takes a column out of its column group.

ui.grid.removeGroupNamed.description: The name of the button that removes a column group of a grid.

ui.grid.reorderColumns.description: The name of the list of columns that the reader can reorder in the column manager of a grid.

ui.grid.reorderRows.description: The hidden name of the header of the column of row drag handles.

ui.grid.resetBody.defaultMessage: This discards the column widths you saved, and the grid sizes the columns to fit its width again. Your other layout preferences — order, visibility, and pinned columns — stay just as they are.
ui.grid.resetBody.description: The text of the dialog that asks before it discards the saved column widths of a grid.

ui.grid.resetConfirm.description: The button that discards the saved column widths of a grid.

ui.grid.resetTitle.description: The title of the dialog that asks before it discards the saved column widths of a grid.

ui.grid.resetWidths.description: The menu item that gives the widths of the grid columns back to the automatic fit.

ui.grid.resizeColumn.description: The name of the handle that resizes a column of the grid.

ui.grid.resized.defaultMessage: {column} column {width, plural, one {# pixel} other {# pixels}}
ui.grid.resized.description: Spoken when the reader resizes a column of the grid. The width is in pixels.

ui.grid.returnedWhereStarted.description: Spoken when a canceled drag in the group editor puts the item back.

ui.grid.rowAdded.description: Spoken when the reader adds a row to the grid.

ui.grid.rowCount.description: The row count in the footer of a grid.

ui.grid.rowGroupName.description: The name of a row group in a reorder announcement, such as "group Active".

ui.grid.rowName.description: The name of a row with no label of its own. The key is the key of the row.

ui.grid.rowRefused.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {Row not added, # cell refused} other {Row not added, # cells refused}}
ui.grid.rowRefused.description: Spoken when the grid does not add a new row. The count is the number of refused cells.

ui.grid.rowsPerPage.description: The name of the control that picks the number of rows on a page of a grid.

ui.grid.rowsResult.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {No results} one {# row} other {# rows}}
ui.grid.rowsResult.description: Spoken when the rows of a grid finish loading. The count is the number of rows.

ui.grid.rowsSelected.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# row selected} other {# rows selected}}
ui.grid.rowsSelected.description: Spoken when the selection of the grid changes. The count is the number of selected rows.

ui.grid.rowsVisible.defaultMessage: {rows, number} of {total, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} visible
ui.grid.rowsVisible.description: The row count in the footer of a filtered grid.

ui.grid.saveCell.description: The name of the button that saves the edit of a cell. The cell names its column and row.

ui.grid.savePreset.description: The button that saves the layout of the columns of a grid as a preset.

ui.grid.search.description: The hint text and the name of the search field of a grid.

ui.grid.selectAll.description: The name of the checkbox in the header that selects every row of a grid.

ui.grid.selectAllOnPage.defaultMessage: Select all rows on this page
ui.grid.selectAllOnPage.description: The name of the checkbox in the header that selects every row of the current page of a grid.

ui.grid.selectRow.description: The name of the checkbox that selects a row.

ui.grid.selectedHidden.defaultMessage: {selected, plural, one {# row selected} other {# rows selected}}, {hidden, number} not shown
ui.grid.selectedHidden.description: The selection count in the footer of a grid, when the filter hides some selected rows.

ui.grid.selectedOf.defaultMessage: {selected, number} of {rows, plural, one {# row} other {# rows}} selected
ui.grid.selectedOf.description: The selection count in the footer of a grid.

ui.grid.selectionCleared.description: Spoken when no row of the grid is selected any more.

ui.grid.showColumn.description: The name of the checkbox that shows or hides a column of a grid.

ui.grid.showed.description: Spoken when the reader shows a hidden column of the grid.

ui.grid.skippedOnly.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# cell skipped} other {# cells skipped}}
ui.grid.skippedOnly.description: Spoken when a paste into the grid skips every cell. The count is the number of cells.

ui.grid.sort.description: The menu item of a grid column that opens the sort choices.

ui.grid.sortAscending.description: The menu item that sorts the rows of a grid by a column, from low to high.

ui.grid.sortBy.description: The name of the header button that sorts the rows of a grid by a column.

ui.grid.sortByPriority.description: The name of the header button of a column in a sort by many columns. The priority is its place in that sort, from 1.

ui.grid.sortCleared.description: Spoken when the grid is no longer sorted.

ui.grid.sortDescending.description: The menu item that sorts the rows of a grid by a column, from high to low.

ui.grid.sortEntry.description: A sorted column and its direction, inside the sort announcement of the grid.

ui.grid.sortThen.description: Joins the sorted columns of the grid in their order, such as "Name ascending, then Age descending".

ui.grid.sortedBy.description: Spoken when the sort of the grid changes. The columns are the sorted columns, in order.

ui.grid.stale.defaultMessage: {step, select, undo {Cannot undo, the cells changed} other {Cannot redo, the cells changed}}
ui.grid.stale.description: Spoken when the grid cannot undo or redo, because the cells changed since the edit.

ui.grid.tableTools.description: The name of the toolbar of the tools of a grid.

ui.grid.total.description: The label of the row that adds up the columns of a grid.

ui.grid.ungroup.description: The menu item that stops the grouping of the rows of a grid.

ui.grid.ungrouped.description: The heading of the columns that are in no group, and their place in an announcement.

ui.grid.unpin.description: The menu item that unpins a column of a grid.

ui.grid.unpinColumn.description: The name of the button in the header of a pinned column that unpins it.

ui.grid.unpinned.description: Spoken when the reader unpins a column of the grid.

ui.grid.withSkipped.description: Adds the skipped cells to a paste announcement of the grid, such as "12 cells pasted, 2 skipped".

ui.grid.yes.description: The true choice of a yes-or-no cell of a grid.

ui.kanban.drag.description: The first word of the name of the drag handle of a Kanban card. The name of the card follows it.

ui.lightbox.next.description: The name of the button that shows the photo after.

ui.lightbox.photos.description: The name of the photo viewer.

ui.lightbox.previous.description: The name of the button that shows the photo before.

ui.listbox.placeholder.description: The placeholder of a picker with no selected value.

ui.map.detail.description: The header of the value column of the data table of a map, when the map names no category field.

ui.map.legend.description: The name of the legend of a map, which names the categories by their colors.

ui.map.zoom.description: Spoken when a key zooms a map in or out, with the zoom as a percent of the fit, such as "Zoom 150%".

ui.map.zoomReset.description: Spoken when a key puts the zoom of a map back to its fit.

ui.navBar.label.description: The name of the main navigation landmark of a page, which a screen reader speaks with its role, as in "Main navigation".

ui.numberInput.decrease.description: The name of the button that makes the value of a number field smaller by one step.

ui.numberInput.increase.description: The name of the button that makes the value of a number field larger by one step.

ui.panel.resize.description: The name of the grab bar that changes the size of a drawer or a sheet, by a drag or by the arrow keys.

ui.passwordInput.hide.description: The name of the button that hides the text of a password field.

ui.passwordInput.show.description: The name of the button that shows the text of a password field.

ui.passwordStrength.empty.description: The strength of a password field with no text.

ui.passwordStrength.fair.description: The second strength of a password, of four.

ui.passwordStrength.good.description: The third strength of a password, of four.

ui.passwordStrength.met.description: Read after a password rule that the password passes.

ui.passwordStrength.meter.description: The name of the meter that shows the strength of a password.

ui.passwordStrength.notMet.description: Read after a password rule that the password does not pass.

ui.passwordStrength.ruleLength.description: A password rule: the password has 8 characters or more.

ui.passwordStrength.ruleNumber.description: A password rule: the password has a digit.

ui.passwordStrength.ruleSymbol.description: A password rule: the password has a character that is not a letter or a digit.

ui.passwordStrength.ruleUppercase.description: A password rule: the password has an uppercase letter.

ui.passwordStrength.strong.description: The highest strength of a password.

ui.passwordStrength.weak.description: The lowest strength of a password.

ui.pdfViewer.closeThumbnails.description: The name of the button that closes the panel with the small images of the pages of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.controls.description: The name of the toolbar of the PDF viewer.

ui.pdfViewer.currentPage.description: The name of the control that shows and picks the current page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.defaultDelay.description: The choice of the usual short wait before the lens opens on a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.delay.description: The caption of the choice of how long the pointer rests before the lens opens on a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.document.description: The name of the group of the Download and Print buttons of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.download.description: The button that downloads a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.goTo.description: The name of the button that shows a page of a PDF. The page is the name of the page, such as "Page 3".

ui.pdfViewer.hideHighlights.description: The button that hides the highlighted regions on the pages of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.hideThumbnails.description: The button that hides the small images of the pages of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.highlightedRegion.description: Spoken when the reader selects a highlighted region on a page of a PDF. The label is the name of the region.

ui.pdfViewer.highlightedRegions.description: The name of the group of highlighted regions on a page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.large.description: The largest size of the lens that magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.loadFailed.description: The error of a PDF that did not load. The message is the error from the PDF reader, in English.

ui.pdfViewer.loading.description: The name of the placeholder of a PDF that is loading.

ui.pdfViewer.magnification.description: The caption of the choice of how much the lens magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.magnifier.description: The title of the dialog with the settings of the lens that magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.magnifierHint.defaultMessage: A lens beside the cursor while it rests on the page, or above a finger that you hold on the page.
ui.pdfViewer.magnifierHint.description: The description of the switch that turns on the magnifier of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.magnifierOff.description: The button that turns off the lens that magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.magnifierOn.description: The button that turns on the lens that magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.magnifierSettings.description: The button that opens the settings of the lens that magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.medium.description: The middle size of the lens that magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.noDelay.description: The choice of no wait before the lens opens on a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.noPages.description: The text of a PDF viewer that has no pages.

ui.pdfViewer.ofTotal.description: Read after the current page number in the toolbar of a PDF, such as "of 12". The total is the number of pages.

ui.pdfViewer.page.description: The name of a page of a PDF. The page is its number, or the label that the PDF prints, such as "iv".

ui.pdfViewer.pageNavigation.description: The name of the group of controls that go to a page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.pageOfTotal.description: Spoken when the current page of a PDF changes, such as "Page 3 of 12".

ui.pdfViewer.pageRegion.description: The name of the scroll region that shows the current page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.pages.description: The title of the panel with the small images of the pages of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.print.description: The button that prints a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.resetZoom.description: The button that sets the zoom of a PDF back to 100%.

ui.pdfViewer.rotate.description: The button that turns the page of a PDF by a quarter turn.

ui.pdfViewer.showHighlights.description: The button that shows the highlighted regions on the pages of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.showMagnifier.description: The label of the switch that turns on the lens that magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.showThumbnails.description: The button that shows the small images of the pages of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.size.description: The caption of the choice of the size of the lens that magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.small.description: The smallest size of the lens that magnifies the page of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.times.description: A magnification of the lens, such as "2.5×". The zoom is the factor.

ui.pdfViewer.view.description: The name of the group of controls that rotate the page, show the highlights, and set the magnifier.

ui.pdfViewer.viewer.description: The name of the PDF viewer.

ui.pdfViewer.zoom.description: The name of the group of zoom controls of a PDF.

ui.pdfViewer.zoomIn.description: The button that makes the page of a PDF larger.

ui.pdfViewer.zoomInTo.description: The tooltip of the Zoom in button. The percent is the zoom that the button sets, such as "125%".

ui.pdfViewer.zoomOut.description: The button that makes the page of a PDF smaller.

ui.pdfViewer.zoomOutTo.description: The tooltip of the Zoom out button. The percent is the zoom that the button sets, such as "90%".

ui.query.after.description: The operator of a date condition of a filter: the date is after the value.

ui.query.and.description: The combinator that a row must match both conditions for, between two conditions of a filter.

ui.query.before.description: The operator of a date condition of a filter: the date is before the value.

ui.query.between.description: The operator of a number condition of a filter: the number is in a range.

ui.query.conditionGroup.description: The name of a nested group of filter conditions inside a sentence, such as "Picked up condition group".

ui.query.contains.description: The operator of a text condition of a filter: the text holds the value.

ui.query.empty.description: The fixed value of a condition that checks for no text, as in "Name is Empty" and "Name is not Empty".

ui.query.emptyRule.description: The name of a filter condition with no field and no value yet.

ui.query.endsWith.description: The operator of a text condition of a filter: the text ends with the value.

ui.query.fieldRule.description: The name of a filter condition with no value yet. The field is the name of its field.

ui.query.isFalse.description: The operator of a yes-or-no condition of a filter: the value is no.

ui.query.isTrue.description: The operator of a yes-or-no condition of a filter: the value is yes.

ui.query.on.description: The operator of a date condition of a filter: the date is the value.

ui.query.or.description: The combinator that a row must match one of the conditions for, between two conditions of a filter.

ui.query.range.description: The value of a "between" condition of a filter, such as "Age between 18 and 65". The min and the max are numbers.

ui.query.selectIs.description: The operator of a choice condition of a filter: the choice is the value.

ui.query.selectIsNot.description: The operator of a choice condition of a filter: the choice is not the value.

ui.query.startsWith.description: The operator of a text condition of a filter: the text starts with the value.

ui.query.textEquals.description: The operator of a text condition of a filter: the text is the value.

ui.query.textIs.description: The operator of the condition "is Empty" of a text field in a filter.

ui.query.textIsNot.description: The operator of the condition "is not Empty" of a text field in a filter.

ui.query.textNotEquals.description: The operator of a text condition of a filter: the text is not the value.

ui.queryBuilder.add.description: The button that opens a menu to add a condition or a group to a filter.

ui.queryBuilder.addGroup.description: The menu item that adds a nested group of conditions to a filter.

ui.queryBuilder.addRule.description: The menu item that adds a condition to a filter.

ui.queryBuilder.combinator.description: The name of the control that picks AND or OR between two conditions of a filter.

ui.queryBuilder.field.description: The name of the control that picks the field of a filter condition.

ui.queryBuilder.fieldMax.description: The name of the upper bound of a "between" condition of a filter. The field is the name of its field.

ui.queryBuilder.fieldMin.description: The name of the lower bound of a "between" condition of a filter. The field is the name of its field.

ui.queryBuilder.fieldValue.description: The name of the value field of a filter condition. The field is the name of the field of the condition.

ui.queryBuilder.group.description: The name of a nested group of filter conditions.

ui.queryBuilder.holdToRemoveGroup.description: The tooltip of the Remove group button, which removes the group only after a long press.

ui.queryBuilder.max.description: The hint text of the empty upper bound of a "between" condition of a filter.

ui.queryBuilder.min.description: The hint text of the empty lower bound of a "between" condition of a filter.

ui.queryBuilder.noRules.description: The warning of a group of a filter that holds no conditions.

ui.queryBuilder.operator.description: The name of the control that picks the operator of a filter condition, such as "contains".

ui.queryBuilder.removeGroup.description: The button that removes a nested group of conditions from a filter.

ui.queryBuilder.removeRule.description: The name of the button that removes a condition from a filter.

ui.queryBuilder.value.description: The hint text of the empty value field of a filter condition.

ui.queryChips.changed.description: Spoken when the reader switches the combinator between two filter chips.

ui.queryChips.filters.description: The name of the row of chips that shows the conditions of a filter.

ui.queryChips.noFilters.description: The text of the row of filter chips when the filter has no conditions.

ui.queryChips.removed.description: Spoken when the reader removes a condition of a filter, such as "Removed Status is Active".

ui.queryChips.switchTo.description: The name of the button between two filter chips that switches the combinator, such as "AND, switch to OR".

ui.rangeSlider.end.description: The name of the thumb that sets the high end of a range slider.

ui.rangeSlider.start.description: The name of the thumb that sets the low end of a range slider.

ui.rating.label.description: The name of a row of stars that gives a score, when no label names it.

ui.rating.valueText.defaultMessage: {value, number} out of {count, plural, one {# star} other {# stars}}
ui.rating.valueText.description: The score of a star rating that a screen reader speaks, such as "4 out of 5 stars". The value can have a decimal part, such as 4.5.

ui.reorder.draggableRole.description: The role that a screen reader speaks after the name of a handle that drags an item, such as "Move Revenue, draggable". Lowercase.

ui.reorder.dropped.description: Spoken when the reader drops a moved item. The subject is the item, with its place when it has one.

ui.reorder.liftHint.defaultMessage: Use the arrow keys to move it, then press Space or Enter to drop it.
ui.reorder.liftHint.description: Spoken after the pick-up of an item with the keyboard.

ui.reorder.liftInstructions.defaultMessage: To pick up an item, press Space. Use the arrow keys to move it, then press Space or Enter to drop it.
ui.reorder.liftInstructions.description: The description of a reorder handle whose keyboard lifts an item with Space and drops it with Space or Enter.

ui.reorder.moveHandle.description: The name of a control that moves an item, such as the drag handle of a dashboard tile.

ui.reorder.moved.description: Spoken when an item moves to a new place in an ordered list.

ui.reorder.movedIn.description: Spoken when an item moves to a new place in a named group, such as a Kanban column.

ui.reorder.pickedUp.description: Spoken when the reader picks up an item to move it. The subject is the item, with its place when it has one.

ui.reorder.reorderHandle.description: The name of the handle that drags an item to a new place in a list.

ui.reorder.returned.description: Spoken when a canceled move puts an item back at its place in an ordered list.

ui.reorder.returnedBare.description: Spoken when a canceled move puts back an item whose place is not known.

ui.reorder.returnedIn.description: Spoken when a canceled move puts an item back at its place in a named group.

ui.reorder.sensorInstructions.defaultMessage: To pick up an item, press Space. Use the arrow keys to move it, then press Space to drop it, or Escape to cancel.
ui.reorder.sensorInstructions.description: The description of a drag handle whose keyboard drops an item with Space and cancels the move with Escape.

ui.reorder.sortableRole.description: The role that a screen reader speaks after the name of a handle that moves an item to a new place in a list, such as "Reorder Alpha, sortable". Lowercase.

ui.reorder.subject.description: An item and its place in an ordered list, inside a reorder announcement, such as "Alpha, position 2 of 3".

ui.reorder.subjectIn.description: An item and its place in a named group, such as a card in a Kanban column, inside a reorder announcement.

ui.reorder.unnamedItem.description: The name of an item in a reorder announcement when the item has no name.

ui.searchInput.clear.description: The name of the button that empties a search field.

ui.settings.appearance.description: The label of the picker for the light or dark theme.

ui.settings.density.description: The label of the picker for the spacing of the interface.

ui.settings.density.compact.description: The density with the least space between items.

ui.settings.density.loose.description: The density with the most space between items.

ui.settings.language.description: The label of the picker for the language and the formats of the interface.

ui.settings.motion.description: The label of the picker for animation.

ui.settings.motion.reduced.description: A motion setting that removes most animation.

ui.settings.sidebar.description: The label of the picker for the behavior of the sidebar.

ui.settings.sidebar.locked.description: A sidebar setting that keeps the sidebar on the screen.

ui.settings.sidebar.offcanvas.description: A sidebar setting that hides the sidebar at the edge until the pointer comes near.

ui.settings.theme.dark.description: A theme with light text on a dark background.

ui.settings.theme.light.description: A theme with dark text on a light background.

ui.settings.title.description: The title of the settings dialog, and the name of the button that opens it.

ui.sidebar.closeNavigation.description: The name of the button that closes the navigation drawer of a narrow page.

ui.sidebar.label.description: The name of the navigation landmark at the side of a page, which a screen reader speaks with its role.

ui.sidebarLayout.navigationBar.description: The name of the bar at the top of a narrow page that holds the button that opens the navigation.

ui.sidebarLayout.openNavigation.description: The name of the menu button that opens the navigation of a narrow page.

ui.signaturePad.clear.description: The name of the button that erases the signature on the pad.

ui.signaturePad.empty.description: The name of a signature pad with no signature on it. The name is the name of the pad, such as "Signature".

ui.signaturePad.label.description: The name of the canvas of a signature pad, when no label names it.

ui.signaturePad.placeholder.description: The text over an empty signature pad that asks the reader to draw a signature.

ui.table.noItems.description: The title of the empty state of a table that has no rows.

ui.tagInput.addTag.description: The name of the button that adds the typed text as a tag.

ui.tagInput.addTags.description: The name of a tag field with no label and no placeholder of its own.

ui.tagInput.added.description: Spoken when tags are added. With one tag, it names the tag. Else it gives the count.

ui.tagInput.duplicates.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {{tag} is already in the list} other {# already in the list}}
ui.tagInput.duplicates.description: Spoken when typed or pasted tags are already in the list. With one tag, it names the tag.

ui.tagInput.limit.description: Spoken when the field holds the most tags that it takes, so a tag is not added.

ui.tagInput.rejected.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {{tag} is not a valid tag} other {# not valid}}
ui.tagInput.rejected.description: Spoken when typed or pasted tags fail the validation. With one tag, it names the tag.

ui.tagInput.removed.description: Spoken when the reader removes a tag.

ui.tagInput.required.description: The validation message of a required tag field that holds no tag.

ui.tagInput.tags.description: The name of the list of the tags in a tag field.

ui.toast.notifications.description: The name of the region that holds the toasts.
